rows.new_takeaway: TV set construction runs on impossible deadlines and constant rebuilds. The job suits people who measure satisfaction in finished episodes, not finished objects.

rows.title: Get it to air! Making the final touches | The Making of 22 Minutes
rows.old_description: Step into Get it to air! Making the final touches | The Making of 22 Minutes with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: The last 5% of a TV episode swallows half the schedule. Working in broadcast means accepting that the final hour will always be the most intense, and treating that as the job, not a problem.

rows.title: I’m Starting a $140,000 Landscaping Job!!
rows.old_description: Step into I’m Starting a $140,000 Landscaping Job!! with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Six-figure landscaping projects come with logistics most clients never see: equipment scheduling, crew coordination, and pricing risk. The estimation work happens before the first shovel.

rows.title: ZechOsborn
rows.old_description: Step into ZechOsborn with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Trades creators on social media are reshaping what students see about real work in their field. Watching how they document a day is itself a useful skill for evaluating careers from the outside.

rows.title: The real reason we use Procreate for our indie game 🎨✨
rows.old_description: Step into The real reason we use Procreate for our indie game 🎨✨ with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Software choice is often a creative decision dressed as a technical one. Picking tools that match how you actually work usually beats picking the industry-standard one.

rows.title: From vendoring at a market to attending a TIFF Fashion Event 💙
rows.old_description: Step into From vendoring at a market to attending a TIFF Fashion Event 💙 with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Creative careers in fashion are often a slow ladder of small public moments — markets, pop-ups, friends' projects — that quietly compound into legitimate ones.

rows.title: Things you need to know to be a fashion designer
rows.old_description: Step into Things you need to know to be a fashion designer with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Fashion design is more production scheduling and supplier management than sketching. Most working designers spend more time on logistics than aesthetics.

rows.title: Day 1 of starting my new job as a baker
rows.old_description: Step into Day 1 of starting my new job as a baker with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Bakery jobs start before sunrise on day one. The career suits people who can shift their sleep schedule and find satisfaction in finishing a shift before most people start theirs.

rows.title: The reality of being a baker - it’s a physically demanding job
rows.old_description: Step into The reality of being a baker - it’s a physically demanding job with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Baking is physical: lifting flour bags, standing through long shifts, moving hot trays. People who thrive treat the fitness side as part of the craft, not a side effect.

rows.title: When The Photographer Risks Everything 💥
rows.old_description: Step into When The Photographer Risks Everything 💥 with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Adventure photography is closer to fieldwork than studio work. The pay reflects what you'll endure to get the shot, and the careers reward people who can keep their head in conditions that distract everyone else.

rows.title: a REAL day in the life at a video production company
rows.old_description: Step into a REAL day in the life at a video production company with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Most days at a video production company aren't shooting — they're prep, edit, client calls, and email. The shoot days look glamorous because they're rare.

rows.title: A typical day as a CNC Machinist
rows.old_description: Step into A typical day as a CNC Machinist with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: CNC machinist days alternate between setup, programming, and watching the machine run. The skill is staying alert during the long cycles so problems get caught before parts get scrapped.

rows.title: Impressive CNC Lathe Machine Turning
rows.old_description: Step into Impressive CNC Lathe Machine Turning with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: A CNC lathe at work shows the appeal of the trade: it's precise enough to feel like math made physical. The careers reward people who like the feedback loop between a program and a part that comes out exactly right.

rows.title: What is a cloud engineer? - simplified
rows.old_description: Step into What is a cloud engineer? - simplified with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Cloud engineers build the systems other software runs on. The job suits people who like infrastructure-level problems, where small decisions affect every team downstream.

rows.title: day in the life as a line cook at a three star Michelin restaurant
rows.old_description: Step into day in the life as a line cook at a three star Michelin restaurant with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Three-star Michelin kitchens are unforgiving by design. The cooks who last treat the intensity as training, not punishment, and most leave with skills that hold up anywhere else.

rows.title: Day in the life of an aesthetician!
rows.old_description: Step into Day in the life of an aesthetician! with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Esthetician days are heavy on close client contact and consistent technique. The work pays best when you can build a loyal clientele over years, which takes more interpersonal skill than the technical side.

rows.title: Day in the life as an Esthetician
rows.old_description: Step into Day in the life as an Esthetician with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Each esthetics treatment is a small project: assess, prep, execute, follow up. The career compounds when you turn first-time clients into a regular book that's stable across slow seasons.

rows.title: Day in the Life of an Apprentice Plumber
rows.old_description: Step into Day in the Life of an Apprentice Plumber with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Plumbing apprenticeships are mostly fetch-and-hold-and-watch for the first year. The ones who progress fast pay attention even when they're not the ones doing the work.

rows.title: Plumbing 101 for apprentices
rows.old_description: Step into Plumbing 101 for apprentices with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Plumbing fundamentals like flow, pressure, venting, and code are universal across residential and commercial work. Mastering them early lets you specialize later without restarting.

rows.title: Inside Sheet Metal Shop - Sheet Metal Bending Process
rows.old_description: Step into Inside Sheet Metal Shop - Sheet Metal Bending Process with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Sheet metal fabrication moves between layout, bending, and welding in a single shift. People drawn to the trade tend to like seeing a flat sheet become a three-dimensional object in a few hours.

rows.title: A day in a life of a pipe fitter
rows.old_description: Step into A day in a life of a pipe fitter with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Pipe fitting work happens on big sites: industrial, marine, refinery. The trade pays for the willingness to travel and the precision to get long welds right under pressure.

rows.title: A Day in the Life of a Pipefitter at Egan
rows.old_description: Step into A Day in the Life of a Pipefitter at Egan with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Working pipefitter days revolve around blueprint reading, layout, and welding. The career suits people who like working on a connected system rather than discrete pieces.

rows.title: A Day in the Life of a Welder | Indeed
rows.old_description: Step into A Day in the Life of a Welder | Indeed with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Welding shifts in production environments are about throughput as much as quality. The welders who get promoted can do both: hold the quality bar while making the daily numbers.

rows.title: Day in the life of Chartered Architectural Technologist Ep2
rows.old_description: Step into Day in the life of Chartered Architectural Technologist Ep2 with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Architectural technologists spend most of their day in software, producing the drawings that builders will follow. The work suits detail-oriented people who like the certainty of constructable documents.

rows.title: Working with Local 1 Bricklayers 🧱 in NYC
rows.old_description: Step into Working with Local 1 Bricklayers 🧱 in NYC with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Union bricklaying in big cities is structured around clear roles, schedules, and pay scales. The trade-off is a strict ladder that rewards patience over hustle.

rows.title: Meet Faye, a Sprinkler Fitter | This is My Trade
rows.old_description: Step into Meet Faye, a Sprinkler Fitter | This is My Trade with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Sprinkler fitters install systems most people will never see in action. The career pays for the rare combination of physical work and life-safety responsibility.

rows.title: Day in the life of an HVAC technician
rows.old_description: Step into Day in the life of an HVAC technician with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: HVAC techs alternate between scheduled maintenance and emergency calls. The career rewards people who can stay calm when someone's furnace dies at -20°C and they're the only one who can fix it.

rows.title: Day in the life of a young plumber episode 6
rows.old_description: Step into Plumbing with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Plumbing builds confidence as much as skill. The first few years are mostly about doing jobs you've watched done many times, and repetition turns nervous apprentices into competent journeymen.

rows.title: A Day in the Life of a 500k a Year Painter
rows.old_description: Step into Painter with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: High-revenue painting careers come from custom work at the top of the market: bespoke car finishes, restoration, or murals. The path is reputation plus very specific technical mastery.

rows.title: Try this framing technique in your photos!
rows.old_description: Step into Photographer with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Composition tricks like this one only land when you've already done the boring framing work hundreds of times. The visible technique sits on top of invisible reps.

rows.title: day in the life as a line cook at a three star Michelin restaurant
rows.old_description: Step into Cook with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Three-star Michelin kitchens are unforgiving by design. The cooks who last treat the intensity as training, not punishment, and most leave with skills that hold up anywhere else.

rows.title: Day in the Life of an Electrician⚡️
rows.old_description: Step into Electrician with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Electrician days mix predictable installation work and unpredictable troubleshooting. The career suits people who can switch between methodical and improvisational without losing focus.

rows.title: Apprentice is laying handmade 76mm bricks!!
rows.old_description: Step into Bricklayer with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Heritage and restoration masonry uses bricks and techniques that haven't changed in centuries. The apprentices doing this work end up with a portfolio that high-end clients pay a premium for.

rows.title: Day three of being a baker
rows.old_description: Step into Baker with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Bakery shifts are repetitive on purpose: the same mixes, the same shapes, the same hours. People who stay treat the repetition as a chance to refine, not a reason to leave.

rows.title: Why Custom Paint Jobs Cost $50,000+
rows.old_description: Step into Car Painter with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Custom paint at this level is closer to fine art than auto body. The price covers labour you don't see: surface prep, masking, candy coats, and clear, each one taking days.

rows.title: Work Safety
rows.old_description: Step into Workplace Safety with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Workplace safety is mostly about catching small issues before they become incidents. The skill is noticing what's slightly off when everyone else is busy moving fast.

rows.title: A Day in the Life of a Prep Cook |
rows.old_description: Step into Cook with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Prep cooks set the rhythm of a restaurant before service begins. The work is unglamorous but visible to every chef in the kitchen, and good prep cooks get pulled into better stations quickly.

rows.title: what does a plumber do
rows.old_description: Step into Plumbing with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Plumbing covers more ground than people expect: residential service, new construction, commercial, industrial, gas. Picking a niche early lets your skill compound in one direction.

rows.title: Fixing Canada's shortage of skilled trade workers
rows.old_description: Step into Carpentry with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Canada has a structural shortage of trades workers, which is good news for anyone entering. The shortage isn't going away in the next decade, and pay reflects it.

rows.title: A Day in the Life of a Safety Proo
rows.old_description: Step into Workplace Safety with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Safety professionals spend most of their time on site walks, training, and documentation. The job suits people who can balance enforcement with relationship-building so workers actually follow the rules.

rows.title: Workplace Safety Culture | OSHA Tips
rows.old_description: Step into Workplace Safety with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Strong safety culture is less about rules and more about social norms — what coworkers expect of each other when no one's watching. The skill in safety work is changing those norms, not just posting them.

rows.title: WHMIS Training in the Workplace.
rows.old_description: Step into Workplace Safety with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: WHMIS isn't a one-time training; the chemicals in any workplace change, and so do the symbols and rules. Treating it as a recurring habit, not a checkbox, is what makes it useful.

rows.title: Auto Body Repair: A Hands-On Career That Keeps Evolving
rows.old_description: Step into Autobody Repair with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Auto body work has shifted with aluminum panels, electric vehicles, and ADAS systems. Technicians who stay current keep their value; the ones who don't get squeezed out by specialists.

rows.title: Industrial Mechanic Millwright Apprenticeship at Loyalist College
rows.old_description: Step into Industrial Mechanic with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Millwright training at colleges like Loyalist is hands-on by design, and the work is on real industrial systems. Graduates often walk into apprenticeships at the companies they trained on.

rows.title: A typical day as a CNC Machinist
rows.old_description: Step into CNC Machining with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: CNC machinist days alternate between setup, programming, and watching the machine run. The skill is staying alert during the long cycles so problems get caught before parts get scrapped.

rows.title: Day in the life of an Aerospace Engineer
rows.old_description: Step into Aerospace Engineering with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Aerospace engineers spend more time on simulation, review meetings, and paperwork than on physical prototypes. The work pays for the discipline to be slow when the stakes are high.

rows.title: Day in the life of an Automotive Technician
rows.old_description: Step into Automobile Technology with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Automotive techs now spend more time at a laptop than under a car. Diagnostics is the high-value skill, and the technicians who get there fastest invest in software training, not just tools.

rows.title: Outdoor Power and Recreation Equipment
rows.old_description: Step into Outdoor Power and Recreation Equipment with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Outdoor power equipment technicians work on everything from chainsaws to snowmobiles. The career rewards people who like small engines and don't mind the seasonal swings.

rows.title: Occupational Video - Outdoor Power Equipment Technician-Recreation
rows.old_description: Step into Outdoor Power and Recreation Equipment with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: OPET careers are quieter than auto mechanics, but the demand is steady because every cottage, farm, and worksite runs on this equipment. The training is shorter and the niche is well-defined.

rows.title: Job Skill Demonstration 1 - Baking / Démonstration des compétences professionnelles 1 - Patîsserie
rows.old_description: Step into Job Skill Demonstration with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Competition baking shows what mastery looks like in the trade: speed, consistency, and presentation under judging conditions. Watching it is one of the best ways to calibrate your own standards.

rows.title: Plumbing 101 for apprentices
rows.old_description: Step into Job Skill Demonstration with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Plumbing fundamentals like flow, pressure, venting, and code are universal across residential and commercial work. Mastering them early lets you specialize later without restarting.

rows.title: Jobs Skill Demonstration - How to Sew
rows.old_description: Step into Job Skill Demonstration with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Sewing as a trade looks simple at competition speed because the foundation work has been internalized. The same is true of every demonstrated skill — the visible part is the smallest fraction of the practice.

rows.title: A Day as a Graphic Designer
rows.old_description: Step into Graphic Design Technology with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Graphic designer days are roughly half production and half coordination. The career suits people who can move between detailed visual work and the conversations that decide what to make.

rows.title: Day in the Life of a Freelance Graphic Designer in Montreal, Canada (Summer 2022)
rows.old_description: Step into Graphic Design Technology with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Freelance design careers are more business than craft after the first year. The successful freelancers spend hours on pricing, contracts, and client management for every hour on layout.

rows.title: Day in the life of a 3D Animator
rows.old_description: Step into 3D/2D Character Computer Animation with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: 3D animator days are long, iterative, and quiet. Most of the work is watching the same five seconds of motion until it looks right, then doing it again with notes.

rows.title: A Day in The Life of  an Electronic Control Technician
rows.old_description: Step into Electronics with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Electronic control technicians work on the systems that automate factories. The career sits between technician and engineer, and people who can read schematics and write basic code do best.

rows.title: Day in the Life of a Software Engineer at Amazon Toronto
rows.old_description: Step into Web Technologies with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Big-company software engineering involves a lot more meetings and code review than people expect. The actual coding fits between coordination, not the other way around.

rows.title: Co-op students drive manufacturing innovation at Toyota
rows.old_description: Step into Mechanical Engineering CAD with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Manufacturing co-ops give engineering students the rare chance to see decisions play out on a production line. The students who get noticed treat it as a real job, not a school placement.

rows.title: How Volkswagen Cars are Painted in Factory
rows.old_description: Step into How Volkswagen Cars are Painted in Factory with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Factory paint lines are a system: pre-treatment, primer, base, clear, robotic spray, oven cure. Knowing the steps helps when you decide whether you'd rather build the system or operate it.

rows.title: Heavy Vehicle Technology - Salzburg, Austria - WorldSkills Competition 2022 Special Edition
rows.old_description: Step into Heavy Vehicle Technology - Salzburg, Austria - WorldSkills Competition 2022 Special Edition with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: WorldSkills competitions show the upper limit of trade performance under judging conditions. Watching them is useful for understanding what mastery in your trade actually looks like.

rows.title: Day in the Life | Electrician Apprentice
rows.old_description: Step into Day in the Life | Electrician Apprentice with a quick look at how the work gets done, what the day feels like, and why the skills matter.
rows.new_takeaway: Apprentice electrician work is mostly assisting until you've passed enough check-ins to do tasks independently. The path forward is being useful in small ways consistently, not impressive occasionally.
